INC-1024.title: Public Cloud Storage Exposure
INC-1024.description: A production storage bucket was discovered with public read access. Configuration scan detected unauthenticated principal '*'.
INC-1024.root_cause: Incorrect access policy and missing bucket-level PublicAccessBlock configuration.

controls.requirement: The entity restricts logical access to confidential information assets and storage to authorized users only.
Role-based access permissions are provisioned according to the principle of least privilege.
Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating least privilege and separation of duties.
The entity implements controls to prevent unauthorized disclosure of sensitive data.
Data-at-rest is protected using authenticated encryption and strict key policies.
Security incidents are tracked, investigated, remediated, and subjected to post-incident analysis.

remediation_playbook.action: Remove public access ACLs and apply PublicAccessBlock to 'customer-data-bucket'.
remediation_playbook.rationale: Immediate containment to stop active data exposure.

remediation_playbook.action: Enable account-level S3 Block Public Access preventive protection.
remediation_playbook.rationale: Prevents downstream creation of public storage buckets by any engineer.

remediation_playbook.action: Review IAM policies and revoke unauthorized wildcard principals.
Enable CloudTrail S3 Data Events & AWS Config automated drift detection rule.
remediation_playbook.rationale: Provides real-time alerting if policy alterations recur.

post_mortem.summary: Incident INC-1024 (Public Cloud Storage Exposure) affected asset 'customer-data-bucket'. Root cause was determined as: Incorrect access policy and missing bucket-level PublicAccessBlock configuration.. Remediation completed with 4 verified containment actions.
post_mortem.root_cause_analysis: Detailed RCA: The resource 'customer-data-bucket' was provisioned or updated with an overly permissive resource-based policy. Lack of mandatory policy-as-code linting allowed this change into the Production environment.
preventive_actions: Implement pre-commit Terraform Checkov / tfsec scans in CI/CD pipeline.
Enforce AWS Organization SCP (Service Control Policy) banning public bucket policies.
Conduct automated weekly IAM permissions review.
lessons_learned: Hindsight memory recall accelerates root cause identification from hours to seconds.
Organizational memory ensures proven remediation playbooks are reused rather than reinvented.
Evidence artifacts must be cryptographically hashed for audit defensibility.
